title: Scenario scene template (D390)
description: A scenario (gameplay, lobby, screen share, starting soon, BRB, ending) as data: the slot boxes of the H scene and of the V scene, each given explicitly (the auto H to V rule is not used). services/scene-builder/scenarios.mjs turns a template into the builder's reference-read shape and lets buildPackage link the slots to the user's own sources, with placeholders where nothing matches. Boxes are fractions of the canvas (0..1). V boxes sit inside the V safe zone (data/clip/targets.json, rules v.safe) and do not overlap; H boxes may overlap (overlays on the picture).

text.description: graphics only: the message shown on the panel (ujwalam-panel ?text=).
